metadata.description: Free Claude Code plugins from Alex Tong — grouped by who they're for: engineering workflow, education, career, and usage stats.

plugins.name: alex-tong-engineering
plugins.description: Claude Code workflow skills for working engineers — scaffold and audit multi-repo workspaces, generate structured PR descriptions from a branch diff, audit CLAUDE.md and .claude/rules/ files for staleness, and measure what actually loads into every session at startup.

plugins.name: alex-tong-education
plugins.description: Educational content skills — create beautiful, printable worksheets as self-contained HTML files for any grade level, subject, or audience.

plugins.name: alex-tong-career
plugins.description: Career research skills — build a saved markdown packet on a company covering culture, work-life balance, leadership, and comp, with an optional role-specific interview deep-dive.

plugins.name: alex-tong-skill-stats
plugins.description: Locally track which Claude Code skills and agents you actually invoke — surface the top hits and the ones you installed but never use. Ships a PreToolUse hook, so installing it is the opt-in; nothing ever leaves your machine.
